scope: Other eviction-policy papers and their first controlled studies or prerequisites; these papers do not share a standardized Stage 1 gate.

papers.name: Episodic Memory Reader
papers.first_study: bAbI Task 2 with clean/noisy streams, 40 facts, 5 questions, memory 5/10/15; FIFO/LIFO/uniform and independent/contextual scorers; 3 runs.
papers.prerequisite: TVQA reader pretrained on annotated relevant frames to match the S+V timestamp baseline.
papers.attribution: Report solvable supporting-evidence retention separately from answer accuracy.
papers.backbone: Joint task/policy training is described; do not call the whole method frozen.

papers.name: Reinforced Neural Processes
papers.first_study: Four delayed dynamical streams; train prefix and held-out final 20%; memory 16/32/64/128; 10 seeds; matched backbone update budget.
papers.reward: Same current predictor and observed future evaluate chosen versus alternative memory.
papers.limitation: Joint improvement does not isolate policy alone; no standalone Stage 1 pass protocol stated.

papers.name: Learning to Evict from Key-Value Cache
papers.venue: ICML 2026 per current arXiv author metadata
papers.prerequisite: Fixed base LLM supplies offline Q/K/V traces; future attention supervises a cached-K/V/position policy.
papers.evaluation: RULER-4k accuracy and OASST2-4k perplexity against random, recency and other policies across matched absolute cache budgets; reward-proxy ablations plus live downstream tasks.
papers.limitation: Future attention is a surrogate and its additive/nested ranking argument does not automatically transfer to complementary visual evidence.

papers.name: Neural Garbage Collection
papers.first_study: Countdown, 250 updates, 1024 held-out problems; increasing eviction curriculum, no-eviction and heuristic controls, replay-mask and eviction-gradient ablations.
papers.backbone: Joint reasoning and eviction, no requirement for an already successful frozen reader.
papers.limitation: Co-adaptation tests a different estimand from fixed-predictor eviction.

papers.name: What Should an Agent Remember?
papers.first_study: Retention by selection factorial design, same 300 episodes, separate target survival and required-fact recall; SQuAD replication.
papers.limitation: An evaluation paper, not a trained deletion policy. Oracle retention/selection are privileged diagnostics.

implication_for_our_project: Propose separate reader usability, matched-state deletion consequences, and sequential retention evaluations before a learned deletion policy. Proposal only; retain all actual failures and original GO rules.
